--- title: "[augment()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-function}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Return an observation-level DataFrame for a fitted model. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/greenwood/blob/main/greenwood/summaries/_registry.py#L231-L276){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python augment( model, data=None, **kwargs, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Produces one row per observation, appending model-derived columns (e.g., fitted values, residuals, or predicted survival probabilities) to the original data. This is the Python equivalent of R's `broom::augment()`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [object]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A fitted Greenwood estimator (e.g., `CoxPH`). [data]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The original data used to fit the model. Required by some adapters (e.g., Cox residuals need the covariate matrix); optional for others. [**kwargs]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Forwarded to the registered adapter. Common options include `format=`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [DataFrame]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : An observation-level summary with predictions or residuals. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Register a custom augment adapter, then call `augment()`. The adapter receives the fitted model and the original data and returns a DataFrame with observation-level diagnostics: ::: {#b0f0ede6 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw from greenwood.summaries import register_augment lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") cox = gw.CoxPH().fit("Surv(time, status) ~ age + sex", data=lung) def _augment_cox(model, data=None, *, format=None, **kwargs): resid = model.residuals(type="martingale") return gw._backends.to_dataframe( {"martingale": resid}, format=format, ) register_augment("greenwood._cox.CoxPH", _augment_cox) gw.augment(cox, data=lung, format="polars") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
